Description.English: A cold front is expected to arrive at the coast of Guangdong tomorrow (18th Nov) during the day, bringing a few rain patches to Macao. As affected by the subsequent northeast monsoon, northerly winds will strengthen in the evening, reaching force 6 with gusts, and temperatures will begin to drop. On Thursday and Friday (19th and 20th), it is expected to be cool and the minimum temperature will drop to around 15 degrees Celsius. The public is advised to pay attention to the weather changes and take appropriate measures.( Update Time: 2026-11-17 17H45 )
